title: Brokkat language - Wikipedia
text: Brokkat (Dzongkha: བྲོཀ་ཁ་; Wylie: Brok-kha; also called Brokskad and Jokay) is an endangered [2] Southern Tibetic language spoken by about 300 people in the village of Dhur in Bumthang Valley of Bumthang District in central Bhutan. [3][1] Brokkat is spoken by descendants of pastoral yakherd communities.
